rationale: Compound ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲭⲓⲟⲡⲉ (Lyc. reflex of ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'become, exist, dwell') = 'place of dwelling, abode.' The chapter title ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲡⲉ = 'the Three Dwellings' is a key cosmological term in this kephalaion. Parallel to ⲙⲁⲙⲟⲩⲣ 'place of binding' and ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲉ 'stronghold' (both already in vocab).

Verb ⲡⲍ appears twice on lines 3-4 in cognate-object construction with ⲙⲁⲡϩ 'splittings.' The parallel construction with ⲡⲁⲣⲭϩ/ⲡⲁⲣⲭϥ̄ ('separations/separated') in line 4 confirms the verbal-cognate-noun pattern. Likely Lyc. reflex of ⲡⲱϩ 'split, divide, strike' with ⲍ for ϩ. Eschatological context fits the fragmentation/sealing of the Enemy at the end.

Eschatological context: 'shall escape from the X that is set for them forever' (line 20). Possibly = ⲥⲱⲣⲡⲉ 'snare' with ⲡ for ⲣ (a feature visible elsewhere on this page in ⲡⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ for ⲁⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ?), or an unattested punishment-noun. Confidence low.

Likely privative ⲁⲧ- + ⲙⲏⲉ ('truth') or + ⲙⲏⲛ ('to abide'). Context: 'those who saw [ⲁⲧⲙⲏⲛⲉ] (with) their eyes' — the blasphemers' deficient seeing. Confidence low; could alternatively read ⲁ-ⲧⲙⲏⲛⲉ 'to the abiding' (positive), but the bracketing of the verse with denouncements supports privative reading.
Lyc. ϩⲱⲕ 'gird' with 2pl reflexive suffix ⲧⲏⲛⲉ. Standard biblical-paraenetic 'gird up' (cf. Eph 6:14). Used here exhortatively before the works of Life.

Distinct from ⲡⲟⲩⲱⲍⲙⲉ 'the answering' (already in vocab). Here the eschatological 'refreshment' (cf. Acts 3:19 καιροὶ ἀναψύξεως 'times of refreshing') withheld from the damned alongside light, breath, water, and dew. Sense determined by context (with waters and dews).
Variant spelling of ⲛⲓⲁⲧⲟⲩ 'their eyes' (cf. ⲛⲓⲁⲧⲉ in accumulated vocab). Vowel-shift ⲁ→ⲉ in unstressed position. Confirmed by collocation with verb of seeing (ⲁⲩⲛⲉⲩ).
